source_name: USPTO Red Book patent grants/applications — explicit machine-readable MathML

official_access.access_mode: Use official USPTO Open Data Portal bulk full-text XML release objects. ODP currently requires authenticated USPTO.gov/API access for acquisition; download on an external executor and never scrape individual patent pages when the bulk XML product is available.

scope.corpus: USPTO Red Book full-text XML patent grants and published patent applications containing machine-readable <maths><math> content
structures: explicit mathematical expressions encoded as MathML
quantitative financial or economic relations when explicitly encoded
scope.original_representation: exact lexical MathML <math> substring inside the patent XML <maths> container
scope.batching: one deterministic content inventory of official ODP release objects per extraction/materialization batch
exclusions: Image-only containers are not treated as attested machine-readable formulas and are skipped without OCR
Do not infer equations from prose, drawings, claims or generic numerals
Do not reconstruct formulas from raster equation images in this lane
Do not assert algebraic, functional, dynamic or family equivalence at extracted stage
Do not process pre-XML APS/SGML products as though they were Red Book XML

snapshot_policy.rule: At run time enumerate the selected official ODP full-text XML release objects, acquire them outside GitHub Actions, SHA-256 each exact downloaded object, record product, release date, official object name and byte size, sort those entries deterministically, and use uspto-redbook:inventory-sha256:<digest> as source_snapshot. Authenticated/signed download URLs are transient transport and never snapshot identity. Any object-set or byte change creates a new immutable snapshot and Internet Archive item.

license_policy.rule: Data.gov metadata marks the USPTO full-text patent grant/application datasets with Public Domain Mark 1.0, and USPTO states patent text and drawings are typically not subject to copyright restrictions, but limited copyright and mask-work exceptions can exist. The acquisition manifest therefore records a rights decision and evidence per acquired object, and the adapter additionally fails closed for redistribution on a patent document when an explicit copyright/all-rights-reserved or mask-work notice is detected. Image-only math is never republished as an extracted equation payload.

adapter.input: root containing externally acquired official ODP Red Book XML or ZIP release objects plus a lightweight audited acquisition manifest
validation: The adapter streams concatenated Red Book us-patent-grant and us-patent-application documents from direct XML or XML members inside ZIP release objects
Only a machine-readable MathML <math> element inside a <maths> container is emitted; image-only containers are counted and skipped without OCR
expression_original is the exact lexical MathML substring from the source XML, preserving prefix spelling, entities and spacing
source_record_sha256 is independent of executor/local acquisition path and depends on immutable snapshot, patent publication identity, exact patent-document bytes, maths ordinal and expression bytes
Patent publication identity, title, publication date/kind, Red Book DTD version/language, source-object checksum and nearby context are retained when available
Explicit copyright/all-rights-reserved or mask-work notices fail closed for redistribution even if the enclosing release object was audited as redistributable
No OCR, equation reconstruction, symbolic normalization, equivalence assertion or equation-family assertion occurs at extracted stage
